title: Odori Park, December 2019
author: sjrankin
why: Sapporo TV Tower seen down snow-covered Odori Park at dusk (Dec 2019, tower lit, early White Illumination) — exact place + snow. Pre-cropped from the 768x1024 portrait to a 16:10 band (768x480) keeping the tower top; image is HDR-processed and below 800px. Landscape alternative: Sergiy Galyonkin 'Sapporo TV Tower at blue hour' (CC BY-SA 4.0, flickr.com/photos/sergesegal/55554006639) — night but summer foliage.
